source_scope.source_statement: Domain Objectはclass化自体を目的にせず、identity/invariant/lifecycle/authorityがないpayloadをEntity/Aggregateへ昇格しない。Value Objectはimmutable、Aggregate更新はroot境界内transaction、Queryはside-effectなし、Domain Eventは完了事実の過去形、domainはPortを介してAdapterへ依存する。`Manager/Helper/Util/Data`等の責務不明名を根拠なしで許さず、testはprivate実装名でなくdomain object＋operation＋oracle IDへbindする。

source_conditions.text: Do not promote a payload to Entity/Aggregate without identity, invariant, lifecycle, and authority grounds; class creation is not an end.
Aggregate updates occur within the Aggregate root transaction boundary.

Domain depends on Adapter through a Port.
